description: Paid ($0.01 USDC via x402 on Base or Solana): diagnose an x402 endpoint the way a paying agent would, without paying it: the 402 challenge format, every accepts[] option, the resource URL, Solana settlement readiness, which wallets can pay, Bazaar/OpenAPI discovery and the browser paywall. Returns every check with pass/warn/fail and a fix hint. Same as GET /api/v1/diagnose. The answer carries a signed receipt (EIP-191, bound to your arguments) that proves later which verdict you got.
